chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Al-Haytham ibn Waqid, who said: 'I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying:'
The one who fears Allah, Allah makes everything fear him; and the one who does not fear Allah, Allah makes him fear from every thing.

key_terms.أَخَافَ: He made to fear, caused to be afraid

ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between fearing God and being protected from worldly fears?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi’s chapter on fear and hope, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the metaphysical principle of divine reciprocity, where God’s protective awe replaces worldly threats for the God-fearing. It underscores the Shia theological view that spiritual consciousness directly dictates one’s existential security, transforming potential dangers into sources of peace.
